title: Left-unitor normalization of a supported negative Koszul pure tensor
statement: Let O be a commutative ring sheaf on a small site, A a commutative ring, rho:A→sections(O) a ring homomorphism, a:Fin r→A, and let N be the ordered negative tensor on the image sections at exponent n+1. For I with q=-card I, the specified canonical negative basis map on I, followed by the inverse left unitor O[0] tensor N←N in degree q, equals the inverse single-complex identification O→O[0]^(q+card I), followed by the specified ringedNegativeKoszulSummand on I. This is an equality of the existing explicit maps, for all n and including zero factors.

source.place: Tags 0622 and 0664, ordered Koszul generators and the graded Leibniz rule; algebraization.tex, Tag 0A0E, lemma-derived-completion-koszul, finite free duality.

proof.text: First prove the generic pure-tensor identity with coefficient degree p=0. Substitute p=0 and expand the inverse left unitor using HomologicalComplex.leftUnitor'_inv. Apply naturality of the inverse right unitor, the whiskering interchange law, and naturality of the inverse left unitor. The inverse left and right unitors of the unit agree, giving the identity. For a supported subset substitute q=-card I, so its coefficient degree q+card I is zero. Apply the generic identity to the canonical negative basis map; the definition of ringedNegativeKoszulSummand gives exactly the other side, with the single-complex degree transport. No factor or scalar is inverted.

lean.statement:
theorem ringedNegativeKoszulBasis_leftUnitor
    {C : Type w} [SmallCategory C] {T : GrothendieckTopology C}
    (O : Sheaf T CommRingCat.{w}) {A : Type w} [CommRing A]
    (ρ : A →+* RingCat.sectionsSubring (O.obj ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat))
    (r : ℕ) (a : Fin r → A) (n : ℕ) (q : ℤ) (I : exteriorKoszulIndex r q) :
    letI := SheafOfModules.isGrothendieckAbelian
      ((sheafCompose T (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj O)
    letI := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory O
    letI := SheafOfModules.symmetricCategory O
    letI := Classical.choice (SheafOfModules.tensorClosed O).1
    letI := Classical.choice (SheafOfModules.tensorClosed O).2.1
    let M := SheafOfModules.unit
      ((sheafCompose T (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj O)
    let N := ringedNegativeKoszul O r
      (fun i ↦ ⟨(ρ (a i)).val, (ρ (a i)).property⟩) n
    ringedNegativeKoszulBasis O r
        (fun i ↦ ⟨(ρ (a i)).val, (ρ (a i)).property⟩) n I.1 q ≫
        (HomologicalComplex.leftUnitor N).inv.f q =
      (HomologicalComplex.singleObjXIsoOfEq (.up ℤ) 0 M (q + I.1.card)
        (by have _hI := I.2; omega)).inv ≫
          ringedNegativeKoszulSummand O ρ a n (ringedSiteRingComplex O) q I.1
